notes.title: Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Recently, we rolled out a new version of The Park. The following was patched in:
[list]
[*]Several save/load fixes.
[*]Some fixes to shout mechanic.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could lose control of the mouse in the menu.
[*]Fixed a slider option that displayed the incorrect number.
[*]Fixed incorrect grammar in extras.
[*]Fixed potential stuck issue in the Sideshow Alley.
[*]Pill trip cam path tweaked.
[*]Several other minor issues fixed.
[/list]

Thank you for playing!
